  • Two IRGC members killed by gunmen in western Iran — internal security stress.
  • IDF reports elimination of an Islamic Jihad commander involved in hostage-taking in Gaza.

  • Northern Border

  • Hezbollah activity daily. Lebanese parliamentary leader vows to unite opponents of any deal with Israel — risk of coordinated political-military push.

  • Strait of Hormuz

  • Iran allows passage for favored states (Russia, India, China) while blocking others. Hormuz remains a bargaining lever and flashpoint for naval confrontation.

  • Politics & International action

  • US House set to vote on amendment to block $3.3B annual military aid to Israel.
  • NATO/European leaders referenced cooperation with US action. Russian bank VTB signals possible re-engagement with Iran banking.

  • 🟢 Good News

  • Israel continues defensive upgrades: Iron Dome and Iron Beam joint drills reported.
  • Pause announcement could reduce strikes if honored.

  • Threat assessment

  • Escalating.
